dinkum-3.meaning: "more than 12 hours" and "one year (26 pay periods)" retain the eligibility and expiry thresholds, and approval and forfeiture conditions remain explicit.
dinkum-3.sense: "flights actually took off and landed" narrows departed and arrived to airborne events, potentially excluding gate/taxi time when logging the instructed travel interval.
dinkum-3.authenticity: "put in for", "have a squiz" and "Give your Timekeeper or an HR Specialist at your agency a shout." are ordinary, naturally used local expressions.
dinkum-3.register: "have a squiz" and "get home" give a light level-2 touch with no unnecessary garnish or swearing.
dinkum-3.tone: "we recommend keeping a log" preserves institutional advice and "you forfeit the leave" retains the firm consequence.
dinkum-3.flow: "The hours are based on elapsed time, and you work that out using the time zone you left from." gives a clean spoken explanation.
dinkum-3.variety: "put in for", "squiz" and "runs out" vary the modest local vocabulary.
dinkum-3.essence: "not officially “performing work.”" preserves the crucial distinction between travel comp time and work, along with the document’s practical order.

pre-fix-yarn.meaning: "we reckon it's worth keeping a log" weakens the stated institutional recommendation into an informal opinion; the substantive eligibility, time-zone and forfeiture rules remain.
pre-fix-yarn.sense: "your flights actually departed and got in" preserves flight departure/arrival rather than substituting airborne time.
pre-fix-yarn.authenticity: "if you're after more detail" and "got in" sound natural in a lightly local guide.
pre-fix-yarn.register: "Have a squiz" and "For the finer points" provide an appropriate light level-2 voice.
pre-fix-yarn.tone: "you lose the leave" keeps expiry firm and "Please get in touch" remains useful staff guidance.
pre-fix-yarn.flow: "any travel comp time you haven't used is gone too: it's forfeited" repeats the same conclusion slightly awkwardly.
pre-fix-yarn.variety: "squiz", "finer points" and "runs out" vary the language without repeated tags.
pre-fix-yarn.essence: "use the time zone you left from" retains the defining calculation advice and original structure.

current.meaning: "TDY travel runs for more than 12 hours and needs a pre-approved authorisation in Concur." preserves both conditions; time-zone and forfeiture rules are exact.
current.sense: "have a squiz" accurately invites looking at the fact sheet; "work out how your hours break down" preserves the calculation sense.
current.authenticity: "Once that date comes round" and "get home" are credible ordinary local speech.
current.register: "have a squiz" with lightly spoken "If you’ve got questions" is the requested modest level-2 touch.
current.tone: "we recommend keeping a log" and "you forfeit any unused travel comp time" retain institutional advice and consequences.
current.flow: "The hours are based on elapsed time. Use the time zone you departed from" is clear and unencumbered.
current.variety: "squiz", "work out" and "comes round" vary the small amount of local phrasing.
current.essence: "aren’t officially “performing work.”" keeps the travel-versus-work distinction central and all sections retain their jobs.

dinkum-3.quote: When your flights actually took off and landed
dinkum-3.original: When your flights actually departed and arrived
dinkum-3.why: Taking off/landing may be later/earlier than departure/arrival; this narrows the timing instruction in a document about accurately recording hours.

pre-fix-yarn.quote: we reckon it's worth keeping a log
pre-fix-yarn.why: Changes the official recommendation into a softer personal opinion; the contract asks that institutional verb force survive.

pre-fix-yarn.quote: any travel comp time you haven't used is gone too: it's forfeited
pre-fix-yarn.original: any unused travel comp time will be forfeited
pre-fix-yarn.why: Gone and forfeited repeat the same conclusion with an unnecessary explanatory tail.

summaries.dinkum-3: Accurate and lightly colloquial, with one narrowed flight-timing expression.
summaries.pre-fix-yarn: Mostly faithful and naturally light, with a softened recommendation and one redundant ending.
summaries.current: Precise, clear and well-calibrated to the light brief.
